summary.text: Frederick L. Walls is the Republican candidate for the Illinois State Senate, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democratic incumbent Elgie R. Sims, Jr.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a journeyman carpenter of nineteen years and a small business owner, and listed property taxes, the small business climate and crime as his key messages.

paragraphs.text: Frederick L. Walls earned a high school diploma from Hillcrest High School, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in construction.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a father of four, a husband, the middle child of eight, a journeyman carpenter and a small business owner.

Walls was the Republican nominee for Illinois House of Representatives District 34 in 2022 and 2024, losing both general elections to incumbent Nicholas Smith, with 21.8 percent of the vote in 2022 and 23.4 percent in 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary for the State Senate seat on March 17, 2026, running unopposed with 2,468 votes.

In the 2026 survey, he said Illinois has some of the highest property taxes in the nation and that he would vote against new mandates and fees on businesses, and he named education and taxes as his areas of policy interest.
